source.title: Differential salivary disposition of linezolid and its two major metabolites (PNU-142300 and PNU-142586) after a single dose in healthy adults

schema_gaps: QuantitativeResult has no dedicated field for standard deviation; SD values were preserved in canonical_statement and original_result_text.
The current atom schema has no explicit censored/BLQ quantitative-result structure; all-sample BLQ findings were represented as qualitative_result atoms with assay LLOQ preserved in a method atom.
extraction_limitations: No correction or supplementary source material was specified or used.
Reference-list claims were not converted into primary-study result atoms; discussion statements derived from cited literature were kept out of quantitative primary-result atoms.
The study re-used stored samples from an earlier study, but this extraction treats dkag280 as the primary publication as instructed.
